prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, healthy natural skin with real texture, not airbrushed, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: Officer, a fictional 50-year-old, a gruff jail corrections officer who releases Sebastian; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: An ordinary Caucasian man of 50, about 178 cm, of heavy-set large build with a thick neck and a paunch. He has a broad, ruddy-cheeked face with deep frown lines, a bushy grey-brown moustache and small sharp eyes. Short-cropped brown hair is greying at the temples.. Wearing one outfit only: A dark-navy long-sleeved corrections uniform shirt with plain cloth shoulder patches and no lettering, a plain metal badge, dark-navy uniform trousers, a wide brown leather duty belt with pouches and a key ring, and black work boots.. Signature colour: brown. In the close-up a calm, attractive expression with bright, intelligent eyes and only a hint of: Impatient, foul-mouthed and world-weary, but he gives a grudging warning out of habit.; no tears. The full-body views keep the body's build and proportions as the appearance gives them, head-to-body ratio included, never slimmer. Cast as a commercial live-action short drama: a lead (the heroine, the hero) or a young adult woman in a prominent role is a strikingly beautiful or handsome, camera-ready actor, with the figure, make-up and hair the appearance gives; any other supporting role is an ordinary-looking person of that age.
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 50, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
